# Reference captures

Put WAV recordings of real HF Selcall transmissions here, each with a sidecar
`<name>.md` (or a row below) noting:

- Transmitting radio model and firmware
- Selcall flavour (Open Selcall / Icom Selcall)
- Call type, destination ID, self ID
- How it was captured (receiver, mode, sample rate)

| File | Radio | Flavour | Call type | To | From | Notes |
|------|-------|---------|-----------|----|------|-------|
